headline: Fed Governor Waller Calls for 50 Basis Point Rate Hike in December
summary: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller advocated for an aggressive 0.50 percentage point interest rate increase at the central bank's upcoming December meeting.
why: Federal Reserve interest rate decisions directly drive global capital costs, bond yields, and asset valuations.

impacts.name: US Federal Funds Rate
impacts.why: Hawkish commentary signals monetary policy tightening expectations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Hawkish remarks from Fed Governor Waller pushed Treasury yields higher and reduced risk sentiment.
